title: This is basically a very commercial smell in a pretty bottle.
text: This is basically a very commercial smell in a pretty bottle.. Doesn't smell as good as I had hoped. It is alright but basically smells like any other commercial air spray or room spray. Not worth the price for the brand. It is only ok.
